items.title: Pharmaceutical company bows to pressure, offers lifesaving drug for free
items.description: Breast cancer patients were considering removing their ovaries until the maker of Zoladex 3.6mg said they would give the drug away rather than list it on the PBS.

items.title: Liberals registered dead and ex-members as preselectors for key seat
items.description: A leaked Liberal Party spreadsheet has revealed that one dead person and two ex-members were registered as preselectors for a vote in a key seat for the upcoming Victorian election.

items.title: 'The winner is Zelenskyy, not Putin': The inland sea where two wars collide
items.description: A large inland sea connecting military supply lines through Russia and Iran could now be a pivotal theatre for two major wars that are usually thought of as separate.

items.title: Live: Hanson seeks to wedge Coalition with Islamic State bill
items.description: One Nation leader Pauline Hanson has sought to wedge the Coalition by seeking support for a counterterrorism bill from the crossbench. Follow live.

items.title: Why Jim Chalmers is cautious but upbeat
items.description: After delivering a pre-election prediction that "the worst of the inflation challenge is behind us", only to see inflation then steadily rise, Treasurer Jim Chalmers is now more cautious.

items.title: The everyday items that have gone up in price — and what's gone down
items.description: The good news this week is inflation has eased slightly. The bad news is it remains stubbornly high. So we've tracked how the prices of everyday items have changed.

items.title: Rise of Ben Carroll 'destroyed' Victorian Labor's Socialist Left, insiders say
items.description: Ben Carroll emerged from a meeting of the Labor caucus on Tuesday as the party's new leader, but what the public did not see was a two-hour fight behind closed doors to decide who would run the state.

items.title: Three dead in Sydney house fire
items.description: New South Wales Police is working to identify the bodies of three people found in a house fire in Sydney's south-west overnight.

items.title: Live: Aussie swimmers make history with rare dual gold, tears for retiring great
items.description: Australia claims a further nine golds in the pool in Glasgow, setting a new Commonwealth Games record. Follow live.

items.title: New data shows Indigenous children face lengthy periods on remand
items.description: New data shows First Nations children are spending longer behind bars without a sentence. Families and experts say the system is failing young people.

items.title: Queenslander could face execution over alleged killing of Australian in Syria
items.description: A 20-year-old Gold Coast mobile phone technician is facing a possible death penalty in Syria for the alleged shooting murder of another Australian.

items.title: Neil the seal's damage bill and management costs revealed
items.description: The cost of managing Neil the seal's biannual visits to Tasmania is in the tens of thousands of dollars, the environment department has revealed.

items.title: Fauci refuses to answer questions in 'unhinged' COVID hearing
items.description: The former top US infectious disease expert declines to answer questions at a Republican-led Senate hearing, labelling it an "unhinged" campaign to see him imprisoned.

items.title: Trump vows to retaliate 'hard' against Iran in expletive-laden warning
items.description: In a phone interview with Fox News, the US president reportedly said the US would "beat the f****** s***" out of Iran in response to the surprise strikes.

items.title: Shifting political views don't need to spell the end of a relationship
items.description: But experts say if morals are involved, it might be a relationship "deal breaker".

items.title: Six artworks to see at the newly reopened Brett Whiteley Studio
items.description: An Archibald winner, an intimate portrait of a marriage and a suburban backyard are among the Brett Whiteley artworks on display at his renovated studio.

items.title: Quiz: Australian musician or Australian Rules footballer?
items.description: Footy and music are two of our most beloved pastimes. How well do you know the stars of each discipline?

items.title: Australians fork out $4 million for failing to vote in federal election
items.description: More than 1.3 million people did not vote in last year's election, and about 200,000 of those have paid the $20 fine.

items.title: Live: Wall Street sinks after a divided Fed keeps rates on hold, ASX set to fall
items.description: It was a wild night on Wall Street with all key indices closing sharply lower after the Fed kept rates on hold. The ASX also looks set to open lower. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: 'Time-limited rotation': Conroy puts an end date on US subs in WA
items.description: AUKUS submarines rotating through Western Australia's HMAS Stirling naval base appear set to stop after 2032.

items.title: More earthquake warnings in Japan as rescuers race to free those trapped
items.description: Earthquake warning alarms sounded on phones in the Kumamoto region again on Wednesday night when a 5.8 magnitude quake hit.

items.title: Jared Leto denies sexual misconduct allegations after documentary
items.description: Ten women have spoken to the BBC about interactions they had with the actor and Thirty Seconds to Mars frontman.

items.title: 'Total conflict': Infantino sets deadline for controversial FIFA scheme
items.description: FIFA boss Gianni Infantino tells member federations they have until September 19 to decide on his controversial private investor scheme with Joshua Kushner.

items.title: Solar is cheap, but building enough of it can be difficult
items.description: Australia is the world’s biggest iron ore exporter, but the Australian Renewable Energy Agency says ultra-low-cost solar could make it a green iron superpower.

items.title: F1 to end season in Europe if no Middle East races
items.description: F1's chief executive confirms a deadline in mid-September to decide whether the season-concluding races in Qatar and Abu Dhabi must be held in Europe due to the Iran war.
